name: Hickory Nut
caution: Sweet hickories are excellent; a few relatives are bitter but not dangerous. The shells are hard, so mind your fingers. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: Shagbark and its kin drop nuts in a four-part husk. Gather early before squirrels clear the ground.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Pecan's richer cousin. Traditionally the whole cracked nuts were boiled and strained into a nut milk that flavored breads and hominy.
